items.description: ImportedEventRelation is expression-level. A future formalization may interpret factor expressions in a connected-sum quotient of closed 3-manifolds.
The current terminal discharge is a Boolean factor-profile theorem, not a formal free-product fundamental-group proof.
WP03 JSON replay and Lean compilation are both repository-native, but the JSON-to-Lean translation is not itself verified in Lean.
No canonical-neighbourhood, neck-detection, cap, continuation, noncollapsing, or extinction theorem is formalized.
Exact Perelman II and Kleiner-Lott transition locations remain archival debt inherited from PC03-D001.
